text:
alice: FYI I opened a docs PR for Windows + ARM64 installer notes and expanded KMS/HSM examples for private installer. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2345. Need review from @ben and @carla — main changes: Windows conn-checker example, PKCS11 sample for HSM proxy on sealed networks, and a short troubleshooting section for HSM time skew and cert imports.

ben: Thanks — skimmed it. A few asks: add a minimal PowerShell conn-check example, call out kube-proxy/nat scenarios in the networking checklist, and mention the NSS/certutil flow for cert import on Windows.

carla: I can add the PowerShell snippet. Also found one broken link to the offline bundle checksum page (we renamed some anchors). I'll fix the link in the same PR. :eyes:

docs-bot: Linkcheck report: 2 broken links detected in PR #2345 -> /install/offline-checks, /examples/hsm-pkcs11. Suggested replacements: /install/airgap/bundle-checks and /install/kms/pkcs11. Labels applied: doc:link-fix.

alice: Pushed an update with the PS snippet and a PKCS11 example. Copying the snippets here — quick sanity check please:

```powershell
# conn-checker minimal (Windows ARM64)
.\conn-checker.exe --host 10.0.1.5 --port 443 --timeout 10 --use-sni --ca C:\certs\redwood-ca.pem
```

```ini
# Example: kms-pkcs11.conf (Windows paths)
provider = C:\Windows\System32\pkcs11.dll
slot = 0
pin = 1234
# note: escape backslashes in example consumers
```

alice: Also added a short HSM troubleshooting bullet: "If HSM ops fail, verify NTP on the appliance and ensure no >5s skew; check HSM logs and re-import cert chain if needed."

ben: LGTM. Two small nits: 1) in docs prefer forward-slash paths for readability with a note that Windows uses backslashes and must be escaped; 2) add a short note in networking checklist about kube-proxy running in masquerade mode and SNAT implications for sealed sites.

carla: pushed a tiny commit updating anchors and one-line about disabling WPAD in sealed networks (seen this bite customers). Also adjusted the offline bundle link to the new path.

dave: I'll review after lunch and do a quick oncall sanity pass. One thing: replace the "systemd" example label with "service wrapper" for Windows and add the certutil import example: `certutil -addstore -f "ROOT" C:\certs\redwood-ca.pem`.

alice: Great, thanks everyone. Plan: merge on green, will add a short changelog entry after merge. :shipit: 

(threads: PR review flow, link fixes, tiny code snippets, and windows/arm specific notes)
